player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ti yaadaa Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Meeshaalee kee '{symbol}'.
Hoogganati dhugaa lamaan sadii (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) hin arginee.
Golee lamaan sadii argite, tii DHIISA.
Golee kee ibsuun formaati '[4]' tiin cell 4 keessatti meeshaalee kee rakkeesee.
Player {player_id} tiin, ati '{symbol}' yoo taatee, garuu duriin kee '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} meeshaalee isaa ({symbol}) cell {cell} keessatti rakkeesee.

outcome.loss: Taphattuun {player_id} dachaa tokko xumuruudhaan ni dhaba!
outcome.draw: Wal qixxaata! Namni tokkoyyuu hin dhabe.
